text.tspan: Four sibling root collections | Full document schemas | Indented rows are embedded map / array members, not subcollections
ID links: rooms.buildingId -> buildings; bookings.roomId -> rooms; monthKeys / calendar booking IDs link bookings and availabilityMonths. Full cardinalities: companion dictionary.
PENDING holds [startAt,endAt). New paymentStatus = UNAVAILABLE; expected advance 40%, no real payment/refund. pricePerDay/deposit are legacy; priceSnapshot and copied names/addresses are snapshots.
